_meta.description: clients-history-summary-and-risk, task 1.1 (REQ-CIN-001). Every client carries a churn risk level with the reasons behind it. ClientRiskService writes it daily and when a contract status or a survey classification changes; nobody types it. It is not marked readOnly in the schema, because OpenRegister then refuses the service's own update; the forms show it read only through the manifest fieldOverrides. The reasons hold signal codes and the record behind each one, never display text, so every viewer reads them in their own language. No property changes type and none becomes required.

churnRisk.title: Churn risk
churnRisk.description: How likely this client is to leave, and why. Worked out from contracts, survey answers, complaints, missed deadlines and time since the last contact.
churnRisk.x-notes: Written by ClientRiskService only. Filter on churnRisk.level for the At risk list.

score.title: Score
score.description: The points of every reason added up.

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: Why the client has this level, one entry per signal that counts.

signal.title: Signal
signal.description: Which signal this reason comes from.

points.title: Points
points.description: How many points this reason adds.

count.title: Count
count.description: How many records the signal counted, such as open complaints.

objectType.title: Record type
objectType.description: The kind of record behind this reason.

since.title: Since
since.description: The date the reason refers to.

computedAt.title: Computed at
computedAt.description: When the level was last worked out.
